description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 06.07.2020 to 12.07.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It establishes new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for international trade. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory procedures governing customs operations.
